features.additionalInfo: With our Altitude Business Platinum credit card, request one additional cardholder and we'll waive the annual card fee for the additional cardholder each year. The primary cardholder is liable for all transactions on the additional card as well as their own card.
Up to 55 interest free days on purchases when you pay off your closing balance in full by the due date shown on your statement each month.

features.additionalValue: Know what to pay when - Set up Card Autopay or SMS payment reminders so you can stay on top of your spend and repayments.

features.additionalInfo: With Altitude Business Platinum, use your Altitude Points per $1 spent on eligible transactions you can redeem a great range of rewards, for you or your business. Altitude Points earned per $1 spent on eligible business purchases: International merchants: 2.5, Australian merchants: 1.5, Government payments: 1
Travel knowing that you, your family, your business and your possessions may be covered against injury, loss, theft or damage in accordance with the policy (conditions, limits and exclusions apply).

International Travel insurance (includes your spouse and certain dependent children) for up to 6 months when you meet the eligibility criteria as set out in the Credit Card Complimentary Insurance Policy.

Make shopping and ordering online even more safe and secure with Westpac My Merchants. Westpac My Merchants lets you shop and order online without needing to share your card details, because your card number is replaced with a unique identification code called a 'digital token'. This digital token, which won't contain your personal information and is used by the merchant instead of your card number, helping protect you online.

Interstate Flight Inconvenience Insurance covers against Cancellation, Flight Delay, Luggage, Luggage Delay and Funeral Expenses when you charge the entire cost of the return interstate flight to your eligible credit card (terms, conditions, exclusions and eligibility criteria apply).

Protection against specified accidental death or injury when sustained while riding as a passenger in a plane, bus, train or ferry when you have purchased the tickets for the entire trip using your Credit Card before you leave (terms, conditions, exclusions and eligibility criteria apply).

Access to up to 4 months Purchase Protection Insurance on eligible purchases, as set out in the Credit Card Complimentary Insurance Policy (terms, conditions, exclusions and eligibility criteria apply).

Up to 24 months extended warranty insurance cover (in addition to the manufacturer's expressed Australian warranty) on a range of personal items purchased using your Credit Card and up to 3 months on Business items (terms, conditions, exclusions and eligibility criteria apply).

Account holder's Unauthorised Transaction insurance - receive automatic protection (up to $20,000 per cardholder and $150,000 per account holder) against unauthorised transactions made by cardholders in a 12 month period (if you are the principal and the account holder of the card).

Westpac Fraud Money Back Guarantee ensures that any unauthorised transaction claims will be reimbursed provided that the cardholder has not contributed to the loss and contacted us promptly. Refer to the Altitude Business Credit Cards Conditions of Use for full details of when cardholders may be liable.

Uncapped Reward Points: Earn up to 2.5 Altitude Points per $1 spent on eligible purchases.
Personal Concierge Service: Priority access, upgrades, savings with dedicated expert support 24/7. Find out more
A statement for the Card Account will be issued each month to the Primary Cardholder

Card Autopay Facility: You may authorise us to automatically withdraw funds from your nominated account to make payments to the Card Account using a Card Autopay facility. You may elect to pay: The minimum payment shown on the Card Account Statement, or the full amount shown as the 'closing balance' on the Card Account Statement, or, A fixed dollar or percentage of the closing balance on the Card Account Statement

The minimum payment that we require from you (being the Primary Cardholder) each month will be shown on the Card Account statement. Your payment due date is 25 days from your statement date. Please refer T&C document for more details about the minimum payment required.

If you have obtained your Card Account by switching from a Westpac consumer credit card to which Credit Card Repayment Protection applied, your Credit Card Repayment Protection policy will continue to apply (unless cancelled by you) to your new card account subject to condition. Please refer T&C document for more details.

Gambling Preference Request: For a Card Account, a Primary Cardholder can request us to decline transaction authorisation requests that we receive and that we are able to recognise as an authorisation request for a gambling transaction. A Primary Cardholder can make such a request (a ?Gambling Preference Request?) by calling us or by another means offered by us from time to time.
Automated Bank Feeds: Westpac makes tax time easier when you set up automated bank feeds from your Altitude Business Platinum credit card to your MYOB accounting software.
Business Money Tools: From cashflow insights to transaction category tags, our business money tools can help you save time on business admin and in control your business finances.

eligibility.additionalInfo: First year Card Fee waiver. The first-year annual Card Fee waiver is available when you apply and are approved for a new Altitude Business platinum credit card. The first annual Card Fee that will be charged will be on the 12-month anniversary of the first transaction made on your account, and annually thereafter. T&Cs apply.

fees.additionalInfo: Payable as a percentage of the Australian dollar value of any foreign transaction. Applies for transactions in a foreign currency, or in Australian dollars but processed by an overseas merchant or financial institution. Note: It may not always be clear to you that the Merchant or entity processing the transaction is located outside Australia.
fees.name: Foreign Transaction Fee

fees.additionalInfo: No Missed Payment fee will be charged for business credit card accounts opened on or after 22 November 2021. May be payable each statement cycle that the whole of the minimum monthly payment is not paid by the statement due date. If charged, the missed payment charge will be debited to your account.
fees.name: Missed Payment Fee

fees.additionalInfo: $15.00 once per statement period if your credit card account was opened before 21 November 2021. No Overlimit fee will be charged for business credit card accounts opened on or after 22 November 2021. May be debited from your credit card account every time you exceed your credit limit during a statement cycle. It is debited from your account in that statement cycle, on or after the day(s) your credit limit is exceeded. This fee may also be charged whenever your account is over limit at the commencement of a statement cycle.
fees.name: Overlimit Fee

fees.additionalInfo: Customers opting in for Data feeds will be charged a monthly fee of $5.00 per Card (up to a maximum of $50 per facility per month) applies when the facility is enrolled in Business Credit Card Data Feeds. The fee will be charged at the end of each statement cycle. Please refer to T&C for more information.
fees.name: Data Feed Fee
